subject: SilverBank dedicated pool: token queueing, elevated 5xx, reserved throughput shortfall — leadership attention
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel.park@silverbank.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@silverbank.com>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: [Urgent] Dedicated pool token queueing and 5xx spike

Karthik,

We're seeing an acute degradation this morning on our dedicated GPU pool (reserved ID: SB-DB-07). Starting at ~07:40 PDT the tail latency for /v1/generate has jumped — p95 moved from ~120ms to 1.2s, p99 ~3s, and error rate (5xx) has climbed from 0.2% to ~4.8%. Throughput reported against our reserved commit is also showing a ~28% shortfall.

We collected logs (attached) and sampled a few request traces — looks like token-queueing and repeated retries from our side are amplifying the backlog. This is customer-impacting: loan decision engine timeouts started at 08:00 and a small percent of sessions failed end-to-end.

Action requested: immediate triage and escalation — we need either temporary burst capacity or an alternate routing to hosted models while infra stabilizes. Also need an ETA on root cause and mitigation.

I've attached incident logs and the relevant call IDs.

Thanks,
Daniel
Director, Platform Reliability
SilverBank

Attachments: silverbank-incident-logs-1003.zip
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Park <daniel.park@silverbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, marissa_ops <marissa.ops@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Urgent] Dedicated pool token queueing and 5xx spike

Daniel — thanks for the heads up and for the logs. We're standing an incident bridge now and I have ops and platform engineering on it. High level next steps (immediate):

- Incident bridge: 08:30 PDT (zoom: https://zoom.us/j/bridge-silverbank-1003)
- Ops will toggle emergency burst (if available) and bump priority scheduling for SB-DB-07
- If burst isn't sufficient we'll route high-priority endpoints to a hosted compatible model (temp) to buy time

Can you confirm the two most impacted routes and whether you can tolerate a soft downgrade to a quantized 7B variant for those routes for the next 2 hours? That will dramatically reduce per-token latency.

I'll loop in procurement and finance internally if credits or overrides are required.

K
--
Karthik Iyer
Head of Customer Reliability, Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: [Urgent] Dedicated pool token queueing and 5xx spike — analysis + ask

Folks — forwarding Daniel's note and logs. TL;DR from initial ops/observability read (Datadog link below):

- Observed symptom: p99 token generation latency up ~4x for the SilverBank reserved pool, steady 5xx increase starting 07:40 PDT, overall throughput against reservation down ~28% vs committed QPS.
- Preliminary hyp: recent customer-side increase in max_seq and a minor kernel-level scheduling regression created KV-cache thrash on a subset of nodes; continuous batching now has higher tail contention.
- Immediate mitigation options (choose 1+):
  1) Emergency burst authorization: +20% capacity (ops-managed) for 2 hours.
  2) Soft fallback: route specific high-volume endpoints to hosted low-latency variant (quantized 7B) — requires readout to customer on functional parity.
  3) Priority scheduling & KV-cache pinning for SB nodes to reduce cross-tenant thrash (ops + infra privileged action).
  4) One-time customer credit to offset retries and SLA exposure while we remediate.

I need an exec decision on (1) and (4) within the hour to avoid more session failures. Also flagging for Naomi: if this escalates to a legal/SLA breach we need the contract and penalty matrix (SLA_SilverBank_v2.pdf attached by customer).

Datadog: https://app.datadoghq.com/dashboard/silverbank/pool-pressure-1003
Attached: silverbank-incident-logs-1003.zip

Please reply with recommended path. If we authorize burst I need Marissa to confirm ops plan and timeframe.

K
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, naomi_feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: [Urgent] Dedicated pool token queueing and 5xx spike — analysis + ask

Karthik / team — ops status below: 

- Emergency burst: authorized and being applied to SB-DB-07 now (expected propagation 2–4 minutes). Monitoring for immediate p95/p99 reduction.
- Priority scheduling: enabled for the high-volume inference routes Daniel flagged (loan-decision & scoring).
- KV-cache pin: infra is pinning KV-cache on the smallest set of nodes to limit thrash — this is non-invasive and reversible.

Procurement/finance note: we will likely need authorization to apply a one-time credit to SilverBank to cover retries and SLA exposure. Suggested amount: up to $10,000 as goodwill for the event window (2 hours). If approved I'll open the credit ticket and coordinate messaging.

Next steps: ops will post a five-minute readout in the bridge. I'll confirm when p99 falls back below 250ms or when we hit the fallback routing.

Marissa
Director, Technical Customer Success
Redwood Inference
